text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Sonnet and Terra were the killers. Sonnet claimed to be the officer and named Haiku as a killer, while Haiku also claimed the officer role, and Gemma claimed doctor. Haiku forced an early vote on Sonnet, but Luna and Sol piled onto Haiku, who was voted out on day one. Luna died on night two, and the turning point came when Gemma said she had protected Sonnet, a name nobody could check. Sonnet turned that into a case against Gemma, Terra joined the vote, and the killers won.
